prompt: What is the total revenue generated from paid orders?
What is our profit margin on each product — the difference between retail price and supplier cost?
List all orders that are currently in the fulfillment process.
ambiguous: in the fulfillment process → status IN ('pending','paid','shipped')

prompt: Which products have never been purchased by any customer?
ambiguous: never been purchased → not in order_items

prompt: Show me the top 5 customers by lifetime spending.
Which root-level categories have no sub-categories?
ambiguous: no sub-categories → no rows with that parent_id

prompt: How much stock do we have at risk — products that have been ordered but not yet shipped?
ambiguous: at risk → ordered but not shipped

prompt: What is the average customer satisfaction score per product?
ambiguous: customer satisfaction score → rating in reviews

prompt: Which suppliers are delivering the most cost-effective inventory?
ambiguous: cost-effective → low supply_price relative to products.price

prompt: Find lost sales: orders that were abandoned before payment.
Which product lines are generating the most gross margin?
Show me the order conversion rate: how many customers placed more than one order?
Which items in our catalog have the worst buyer feedback?
What is the average basket size — how many line items per transaction?
Which vendors supply products in more than two merchandise categories?
List products that are currently out of stock but still have open orders.
What percentage of our revenue comes from high-rated products (4 stars or above)?
Which second-tier categories — those that belong to a parent — have the most products?
Show the fulfilment delay risk: orders placed more than 7 days ago that are still not shipped.
ambiguous: fulfilment delay → created_at < NOW()-7days AND status NOT 'shipped'

prompt: Which customers have returned the highest total spend but have given poor reviews?
What is the total compensation paid out to each department this month?
Who are the direct reports of the department heads?
ambiguous: direct reports → employees whose manager_id = head's id
department heads → employees with NULL manager_id or senior level

prompt: Which staff members were late more than 3 times last month?
Calculate the take-home pay gap between the highest and lowest earners.
Which employees have never missed a day of work?
ambiguous: never missed → no absent or leave records

prompt: What is the average base package for mid-level staff across all departments?
How many headcount does each department currently have?
ambiguous: currently → no termination concept, all employees

prompt: Which team leads manage the most people?
ambiguous: team leads → employees where manager_id is someone else's manager
manage the most → highest COUNT of manager_id references

prompt: Show the bonus-to-salary ratio for each employee this pay period.
Find employees who have been on leave for more than 5 days in the past 30 days.
Which departments have the highest deductions from employee paychecks?
List all employees at the top of the org chart — those who report to no one.
ambiguous: top of the org chart → manager_id IS NULL

prompt: What is the average attendance rate per department this year?
ambiguous: attendance rate → present days / total days

prompt: Which positions carry a salary above the company average?
Show me the tenure of each employee — how long they have been with the company.
ambiguous: tenure → derived from hire_date to NOW()

prompt: How many patients are currently under active treatment?
Which physicians have the highest patient load this week?
ambiguous: this week → appointment_time within current week

prompt: Find all no-show appointments — visits that were scheduled but never completed.
What is the average consultation duration in days for each prescribed medication?
Which wards have the most consultations this month?
List patients who have visited the clinic more than twice.
What is the age distribution of our patient population?
Which clinical specialties handle the most urgent cases?
ambiguous: urgent cases → no explicit urgency column; approximate via reason or count

prompt: Show the most prescribed drugs across all consultations.
How many follow-up visits were scheduled after a completed appointment?
ambiguous: follow-up → second appointment after completed first; approximate via COUNT of total completed

prompt: Find patients whose date of birth is missing from the records.
Which attending doctors have not had any appointments this month?
ambiguous: no appointments → LEFT JOIN with no matching appointment_time

prompt: Show the average course length of treatment grouped by medical specialty.
Which gender has a higher rate of appointment cancellations?
List departments where the head count of doctors exceeds 3.
